module: Module 4: Order Execution, Modification & Bulk Routing
title: Master Modifies Stop-Loss and Take-Profit on Open Block
precondition: 10 sub-accounts have open EURUSD child positions.Master updates SL to 1.0700 and TP to 1.0900.
steps: 1. Master modifies SL/TP on master ticket.
expected_result: Bulk modification fan-out updates SL=1.0700 and TP=1.0900 across all 10 child tickets within 200ms; zero desynchronized child orders.
actual_result: Position protection endpoint (PUT /v1/oms/{instance}/positions/{market_order_id}/protection) fan-outs SL/TP updates to open positions.
